name: What factors should I consider when planning a new kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when planning a new kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: When planning a new kitchen layout, consider your daily routines, how many people use the kitchen simultaneously, and your entertaining habits. Think about the 'work triangle' efficiency between the sink, refrigerator, and stove, and how to optimize flow. Storage needs, appliance choices, and countertop space are also crucial. Additionally, consider how the kitchen connects with adjacent living areas and how natural light can be maximized. We work with clients to evaluate their specific needs and preferences to create a functional and aesthetically pleasing design tailored to their home in areas like Berkeley or Albany.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your routines, the 'work triangle', storage, appliances, and overall flow, as these factors determine a functional and aesthetically pleasing design.
